changeSet.author: logos
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE notifications ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, body TEXT NULL, payload JSONB NULL, source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('webservice', 'orchestrator')), actor_user_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() );
-- The inbox lists newest-first. CREATE INDEX idx_notifications_created ON notifications (created_at DESC);

changeSet.author: logos
logos
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE notification_reads ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, notification_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES notifications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, read_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() );
-- One read row per (notification, user). CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_notification_reads ON notification_reads (notification_id, user_id); -- "Has user X read anything I haven't told them about yet" and -- the mark-all-read sweep both key off the user. CREATE INDEX idx_notification_reads_user ON notification_reads (user_id);
